title: Tensor-power multiplication data for a homogeneous polynomial Proj section
statement: Let k be a field, d>0, f a homogeneous polynomial of degree d on P=Proj k[x_0,x_1] [def-sc-p1-standard]. For L=O_P(d) and the section f/1 [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], there exist isomorphisms a_n:L^tensor n ~= O_P(nd) and b_mn:O_P(m) tensor L^tensor n ~= O_P(m+nd), for all n in N and m in Z, carrying the nth tensor power of f/1 to f^n/1, and carrying its product with a section of O_P(m) to multiplication by f^n.

proof.text: Take the isomorphisms μ of lem-sc-p1-twist-multiplication together with their formula on elementary tensor sections. The morphism homOfGlobalSection applied to the global section of unitToTwist is unitToTwist itself: both maps agree at 1 over the top open, and a morphism out of the structure sheaf is determined by this value.

Induct on n to construct a_n and prove on every open U and point x of U that a_n applied to the nth tensor-power section at 1 has value f^n/1. For n=0 use the source-library unitIsoTwistZero (transported to the category of scheme modules); the value is 1. For the successor compose id tensor a_n with μ_{d,nd}, then transport the integer degree along d+nd=(n+1)d. Naturality of elementary tensor sections and the pointwise formula for μ give (f/1)(f^n/1)=f^(n+1)/1. The value formula for unitToTwist and extensionality out of the unit prove the first morphism identity.

Set b_mn to id tensor a_n followed by μ_{m,nd}, transporting the harmless 0+nd in its degree. The inverse right unitor sends t to t tensor 1. The two whiskerings send this to t tensor a_n(s^tensor n(1)). At each x its image under μ is t(x) times f^n/1 by the induction invariant. This is exactly the pointwise definition of twistMul m f^n. Extensionality of module morphisms and of their fraction-valued sections proves the second identity. No positivity or nonzero assumption is used in these pointwise calculations, so n=0 and f=0 and negative m are included.

lean.statement:
theorem proj_homogeneous_section_tensor_powers_data (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hf : f ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d) :
    let L := Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (0 + (d : ℤ))
    ∃ (a : ∀ n : ℕ, L.tensorPow n ≅
          Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
            (0 + ((n • d : ℕ) : ℤ)))
        (b : ∀ (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ),
          Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m ⊗ L.tensorPow n ≅
            Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
              (m + ((n • d : ℕ) : ℤ))),
        (∀ n : ℕ, tensorPowSection
            (homOfGlobalSection L ((Proj.unitToTwist hf).app ⊤ (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ 1)))
            n ≫ (a n).hom =
          Proj.unitToTwist (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n hf)) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ),
          (ρ_ (Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m)).inv ≫
            Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) m ◁
              tensorPowSection
                (homOfGlobalSection L ((Proj.unitToTwist hf).app ⊤ (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ 1)))
                n ≫ (b m n).hom =
            Proj.twistMul m (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n hf))
